findings.summary: Source job lease fencing is modeled but not enforced by durable runtime claims
findings.details: S06-T01 requires replacing the demo workpool with fenced source job claims using sourceProcessingJobs leases/CAS so at-least-once duplicate workers accept only one logical effect. The implementation adds table schema and pure reducer tests, but the Confect runtime functions only enqueue @convex-dev/workpool actions and return pool status. No internal mutation creates/claims/heartbeats/completes a sourceProcessingJobs row with compare-and-set, idempotencyKey/effectKey dedupe, or stale onComplete fencing. As a result concurrent duplicate deliveries, replayed enqueue requests, or stale completion callbacks are not safety-enforced in persisted Convex state.
